say:1:1721227001:1.text: Ramir couldn't possibly have done anything criminal! He just went to the place to play a few cards and enjoy himself... There has to be some mistake!
say:1:1721227001:1.source_cn: 拉米尔怎么可能犯罪？！他就是去会馆里打打牌，消费享受一...

say:3:1721227002:1.text: Ma'am, I don't think you understand the situation you're in.
say:3:1721227002:1.source_cn: 女士，看来你还不太清楚情况。

say:4:1721227003:1.text: We already know that not long ago, you and Ramir sold Baron Grandet a so-called "neon carp" for one million gold.
say:4:1721227003:1.source_cn: 我们都查到了，就在前段时间，你们以一百万的高价卖给了葛...

say:5:1721227004:1.text: ... Yes, that part is true. Sure, the price may have been steep, but it was still a legitimate sale! Ask Grandet yourself, he was the one desperate to buy it!
say:5:1721227004:1.source_cn: ……是，是这样没错……价格是贵了点，但我们是合法买卖！...

say:6:1721227005:1.text: Except you passed off an ordinary fish as something extraordinary. You exaggerated its value, made false claims about its effects, and used those claims to drive the price up.
say:6:1721227005:1.source_cn: 但你们以次充好，明明只是一条普通的鱼，你们却夸大其词，...

say:7:1721227006:1.text: You said soup made from it could preserve youth, and that the finest ones, used as medicine, could cure any illness... Those were your exact words, weren't they?
say:7:1721227006:1.source_cn: 声称霓光鲤熬煮的鱼汤能令青春常驻，极品霓光鲤入药能疗愈...

say:9:1721227008:1.text: Given the amount involved, this is no petty trick. This is serious fraud.
say:9:1721227008:1.source_cn: 按金额论断，这已经属于一起重大诈骗案，情节严重，影响恶劣。

say:10:1721227009:1.text: We'll decide exactly what to charge you with once the questioning is done.
say:10:1721227009:1.source_cn: 你们的罪名，我们会在全部审讯结束后再进行具体评断。

say:11:1721227010:1.text: For now, ma'am, I need you to answer a few questions honestly. Tell the truth. If you don't, you'll only make things worse for yourself.
say:11:1721227010:1.source_cn: 至于现在，女士，我需要你诚实地回答几个问题。务必说实话...

say:14:1721227012:0.text: I... I'd been complaining to Ramir because I couldn't get a table at Silken Snare. There's a famous dish there people always talk about—the one that's supposed to keep you young forever.
say:14:1721227012:0.source_cn: 我、我之前和拉米尔抱怨预定不到丝绒陷阱的桌位，吃不上那...

say:15:1721227013:0.text: He couldn't get a reservation either, so he brought me fish soup instead and said it would make me look younger. I thought it was just one of those silly beauty remedies people like to talk up, nothing more...
say:15:1721227013:0.source_cn: 他也预定不到桌位，作为补偿，就送给我一道鱼汤，说是吃了...

say:16:1721227014:0.text: And when you said you felt like you were back in your twenties, was that true?
say:16:1721227014:0.source_cn: 你说你的身体状态回到了二十岁，这是真的吗？

say:17:1721227015:0.text: That was just me exaggerating! Besides, I am in my twenties!
say:17:1721227015:0.source_cn: 这只是夸张的说法！而且，而且我本来就二十几岁……

choice:13:0:1.text: What exactly was that fish soup about?
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 你喝的那道鱼汤是怎么回事？
choice:13:0:1.male: What exactly was that fish soup about?
choice:13:0:1.female: What exactly was that fish soup about?

say:19:1721227017:0.text: We were short on money. Ramir said he had a few of those beauty fish, and we thought we could sell one for more than it was worth.
say:19:1721227017:0.source_cn: 我们最近有点缺钱，拉米尔说他有几条这种能美容的鱼，我们...

say:20:1721227018:0.text: He said Baron Grandet would be an easy mark because he was... well... a man with more money than sense...
say:20:1721227018:0.source_cn: 他说葛朗台男爵是个很好的人选，说他……呃，人傻钱还多……

choice_prompt:21:1721227018.text: He said Baron Grandet would be an easy mark because he was... well... a man with more money than sense...
choice_prompt:21:1721227018.source_cn: 他说葛朗台男爵是个很好的人选，说他……呃，人傻钱还多……

say:22:1721227019:0.text: I only meant to sell it for a little more than usual! I never expected Ramir to ask for a million right out of the gate!
say:22:1721227019:0.source_cn: 我只是打算卖稍微贵一点！没想到拉米尔胃口那么大，张口就...

say:23:1721227020:0.text: And Grandet was so determined to buy it that once Ramir named the price, there was no stopping him...
say:23:1721227020:0.source_cn: 那个葛朗台男爵也是，不知怎的非得要买，我拦都拦不住……

choice:21:1:2.text: Even so, a million gold is outrageous, don't you think?
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 你们骗一百万是不是太过分了？
choice:21:1:2.male: Even so, a million gold is outrageous, don't you think?
choice:21:1:2.female: Even so, a million gold is outrageous, don't you think?

choice:13:1:2.text: Did you work together to cheat Grandet?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 你承认你们合伙诈骗葛朗台吗？
choice:13:1:2.male: Did you work together to cheat Grandet?
choice:13:1:2.female: Did you work together to cheat Grandet?

say:24:1721227021:0.text: A fish that could save the king? What are you talking about? I don't understand. What does any of this have to do with His Majesty?
say:24:1721227021:0.source_cn: 伪造霓光鲤……救国王？你在说什么，我怎么听不懂？这件事...

say:25:1721227022:0.text: Captain Fernand gives her a quick explanation. She already looked unsettled before, but now the fear on her face is impossible to miss...
say:25:1721227022:0.source_cn: 费南队长简要地向她讲述了前因后果。女子本就难看的神情更...

say:26:1721227023:0.text: What?! That fish is nothing like that! At most, people say it's good for your skin. How could it possibly do anything like that?
say:26:1721227023:0.source_cn: 什么？！这种鱼最多就是能保养皮肤，怎么可能有那种功效！

say:27:1721227024:0.text: Ramir never told me it had anything to do with the king! He just wanted me to help talk Grandet into paying a fortune for the fish, that's all!
say:27:1721227024:0.source_cn: 拉米尔从没和我说过这鱼和国王陛下有什么关系！他只是叫我...

say:28:1721227025:0.text: If I'd known he was brazen enough to drag the king into this, I never would've gone along with it in the first place!
say:28:1721227025:0.source_cn: 要是我知道他胆子这么大，竟然敢攀附陛下……我从一开始就...

choice:13:2:3.text: Why invent this story about a cure-all fish?
choice:13:2:3.source_cn: 你们伪造能救国王的霓光鲤，有什么目的？
choice:13:2:3.male: Why invent this story about a cure-all fish?
choice:13:2:3.female: Why invent this story about a cure-all fish?

say:29:1721227026:0.text: I'm telling the truth! I would never joke about something like that with the royal family involved! You have to believe me!
say:29:1721227026:0.source_cn: 我真的没说谎，我不敢拿王室的事情开玩笑！你们，你们一定...

say:30:1721227027:0.text: Thank you for cooperating. As for what happens next, you'll be informed once the questioning is over.
say:30:1721227027:0.source_cn: 感谢你的配合。至于结果，全部审讯结束后自然会告诉你。
